items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I had to go out and find me a saxophone player... and I found Greely. And that's how I got out of the band.

ctx.x: player. So I told him about when I was leaving... So you know, you had to give your notice on payday, or the first day after payday. So payday I told Fess, I said, "Fess, I've got to give you my notice." "You can't give me your notice!" I said, "Why?" "You've got to get somebody to take your place!" Well, see, I was involved in getting musicians and all of that. But that's just what he said! So I had to go out and find me a saxophone player that played flute and clarinet and piano -- and I found Greely. And…
